subject.title: Telegram group chat history entries lose media data (only placeholder text preserved)

question: Should Telegram retain and reattach recent media from unmentioned group messages for a later mentioned turn, and under what opt-in, TTL, and access boundaries?
rationale: The source path is clear, but preserving attachments from messages that did not address the bot changes the privacy and retention boundary for group media; automation should not choose that policy.

options.title: Approve Bounded Opt-In Retention
options.body: Allow Telegram to preserve recent local image media only when an explicit group/topic policy permits it, with short TTL, sender/access checks, and live proof.

options.title: Keep Text-Only Unmentioned History
options.body: Leave unmentioned group media as text/placeholder context only and close this behavior as intentionally unsupported for privacy.

options.title: Limit Work To Ingest Hooks
options.body: Continue with the separate ingest-enabled media path and leave later-mentioned media history unresolved unless a maintainer opens a narrower policy item.

recommendation.title: Approve Bounded Opt-In Retention
recommendation.body: Allow Telegram to preserve recent local image media only when an explicit group/topic policy permits it, with short TTL, sender/access checks, and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work on passive hooks and rolling Telegram group history makes this the strongest available owner signal for the policy boundary.
